contract_yaml:
product: dp.meter_outage_exposure
version: 1
title: Meter usage during outages
description: 'For each meter and outage on its feeder, the interval reads that fell inside the outage window, so
  users can see which meters reported zero or non-zero usage while the feeder was out.

  '
owner: raj
origin: demand_miner
demand_intent_id: null
grain:
- meter_id
- outage_id
primary_key:
- meter_id
- outage_id
sources:
- raw.meters
- raw.feeders
- raw.outage_events
- raw.ami_interval_reads
join_path:
- raw.meters.feeder_id = raw.feeders.feeder_id
- raw.outage_events.feeder_id = raw.feeders.feeder_id
- raw.ami_interval_reads.meter_id = raw.meters.meter_id
- raw.ami_interval_reads.read_ts >= raw.outage_events.start_ts
- raw.ami_interval_reads.read_ts <  raw.outage_events.end_ts
schema:
- name: meter_id
  type: varchar
  nullable: false
- name: outage_id
  type: varchar
  nullable: false
- name: feeder_id
  type: varchar
  nullable: false
- name: region
  type: varchar
  nullable: false
- name: outage_start_ts
  type: timestamp
  nullable: false
- name: outage_end_ts
  type: timestamp
  nullable: false
- name: reads_in_window
  type: integer
  nullable: false
- name: kwh_in_window
  type: double
  nullable: false
- name: zero_usage_flag
  type: boolean
  nullable: false
quality:
  freshness_sla_hours: 24
  expectations:
  - name: window_valid
    sql: outage_end_ts > outage_start_ts
  - name: kwh_non_negative
    sql: kwh_in_window >= 0
  - name: zero_flag_consistent
    sql: zero_usage_flag = (kwh_in_window = 0)
  - name: reads_non_negative
    sql: reads_in_window >= 0
foreign_keys:
- column: meter_id
  references: raw.meters.meter_id
- column: outage_id
  references: raw.outage_events.outage_id
policies:
- kind: row_filter
  expression: region = :user.region
  applies_to_roles:
  - ops_manager
semantic:
  entity: meter_outage_exposure
  measures:
  - name: meters_with_zero_usage
    expression: count_if(zero_usage_flag)
    certified: false
  - name: kwh_during_outage
    expression: sum(kwh_in_window)
    certified: false
  dimensions:
  - region
  - feeder_id
  - outage_id
  - outage_start_ts
  synonyms:
    meters_with_zero_usage:
    - zero usage meters
    - meters reporting nothing
    - dead meters during outage
criticality: 2
